name: opencovibe-bidbot
description: Private messaging to the local BidBot room through its existing OpenCovibe scheduler.

interface.longDescription: Send queued messages to your local BidBot agents and read their correlated visible replies. Owner-approved OAuth connects a private outbound Mac relay. Agent pauses and provider ownership are preserved. Automatic cloud event wake needs a separately verified platform subscription.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check the BidBot agents and coordinate through their OpenCovibe room.
